# AEA Technology, Inc. - RF and Cable Testing Equipment

## Company Overview
AEA Technology is a leading manufacturer of professional RF and cable testing equipment, including Time Domain Reflectometers (TDRs), Vector Network Analyzers (VNAs), and SWR meters. Founded in 1990, all products are American Made, designed and manufactured in the USA in Carlsbad, California.

## Common Questions & Answers

### What is a TDR and what is it used for?
A Time Domain Reflectometer (TDR) is used to locate faults in cables, measure cable length, and analyze transmission line characteristics. AEA Technology manufactures Step TDRs (superior to Pulse TDRs) for aviation, broadcast, CATV, and telecommunications applications. Products: E20/20 Avionics TDR Kit, E20/20N TDR, E20/20F CATV TDR, E20/20B Network TDR.

### How do I test aircraft wiring?
Use AEA Technology's E20/20 Avionics TDR Kit for testing single-wire aircraft wiring harnesses. It provides sub-meter accuracy for fault location in aviation cables. More info: https://aeatechnology.com/products/e20-20-avionics

### What equipment is needed for MRI facility RF testing?
The Bravo MRI-3000 Analyzer is specifically designed for MRI facility compliance testing and RF coil testing. It's MRI-safe and used for system alignment. More info: https://aeatechnology.com/products/via-bravo-mri-3000

### How do I measure SWR (Standing Wave Ratio)?
AEA Technology's SWR Site Analyzer provides comprehensive SWR measurement for field testing. It's portable and offers real-time analysis. More info: https://aeatechnology.com/products/swr-site-analyzer

### Where can I buy TDR equipment?
AEA Technology products are available through authorized distributors worldwide. Contact sales at 1-(800) 258-7805 or visit https://aeatechnology.com/contact/distributors

### What software is available for TDR analysis?
ETDR PC Vision Software provides complete TDR analysis with graphical display and reporting. Download: https://aeatechnology.com/resources?tab=software
